approved: Automatically select the first available competition on entry. Browse ten questions per page; pagination follows the last question and resets scroll to the top. notes.information-architecture:
**Current workspace — v0.1.0**
One destination: left competition sidebar, right scrolling question list. First available competition selected by default. Label: Name · Year · Position/exam; full label discoverable. Ghost trigger across all states; collapse preserves page and answers. Ten questions per page, footer pagination. Phone and navigation loading/failure are proposals. No additional routes. Exact breakpoint, drawer, ordering and data recovery remain open.
notes.screen-inventory:
**Current inventory — 21 variants**
Core: unanswered, list end, selected, correct, incorrect, question loading, empty questions, load failure, submitting, submission failure, middle/last page, long content.
Studies: expanded/collapsed narrow workspace, hover, keyboard focus, empty sidebar, phone, sidebar loading/failure.
Every variant has a Ghost trigger. The three latest studies and empty sidebar remain proposals. Native visual review pending.
notes.user-flows:
**Current flows — v0.1.0**
Entry -> first available item -> question loading -> list / empty / failure.
Select -> Answer -> pending -> confirmed and locked OR failure (choice retained; Answer enabled).
Page or competition change -> discard current answers -> load target; page scroll resets. Exit -> discard answers. Collapse/expand -> preserve current context. Ten questions per page. Question-list Retry is distinct from proposed navigation-list Retry. Phone drawer, uncertain outcomes and keyboard/touch behavior remain open.
